objects.name: base
objects.prompt: Create ONE individual **2D top-down pixel-art furniture sprite** for a Unity game using a 32×32 pixel tile grid.  Object: [INSERT OBJECT NAME, e.g. long wooden sofa].  Style: Cozy rustic island-house RPG, warm orange-brown wood, natural colors, matching a wooden house interior with orange wooden plank flooring. Inspired by classic farming and survival RPG pixel art.  Technical requirements: - Strict top-down / three-quarter top-down game perspective. - Crisp pixel art, hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur. - Transparent background. - No floor, no room, no grid lines, no characters, no text, no watermark. - Center the entire object in the image. - Keep the complete silhouette visible with no cropping. - Use consistent lighting from the upper-left and a subtle pixel-art shadow underneath where appropriate. - Design the object to occupy a sensible number of 32×32 tiles. - Keep the same pixel density, outline style, color palette, and perspective as other furniture sprites from this game. - Make the sprite suitable for direct import into Unity as a 2D Sprite. - Do not add extra furniture or decorative objects.  Output only the requested individual furniture sprite.
